notes: Encoded ONLY from Inter-City's own page. No ICP-family page imported. Counting tested both ways on Style 1 (Nordyne lesson): digit-only counting gives year '20' but week '67' (invalid, >53), while character counting gives year 1992 and week 6 (both valid), so digit-only counting is falsified by the page's own example and character counting ships. Style 2 decodes identically under both countings.

styles.notes: Page: year = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits, week = 4th & 5th numerical digits. Character counting (the reading that validates): year = normalized [1,3] = '92' -> 1992, week = [3,5] = '06' -> week 6. Digit-only counting is falsified: it would give week '67', invalid.

styles.notes: Page: year = 1st & 2nd numerical digits -> normalized [0,2] = '94' -> 1994, week = 3rd & 4th numerical digits -> [2,4] = '14' -> week 14. Identical under character and digit-only counting (leading characters are digits).
